svg.text: Ninety-one days from judgment to deletion
Court of Justice, Grand Chamber. Almost no page describing the scheme names it.
Gazette 21,474. Substituted article 10(9) of Cap. 188, the enabling provision.
Gazette 21,478. Retitled S.L. 188.06; removed Part IV and two Schedules.
The agency's own pages show the old figures
600,000 € and 750,000 € under February 2026 timestamps, seen 6 September 2026.
